title: robosimu: oracle-free visual reaching with the İskender Governor (perceptual 1/e speed governor)
description: Rigid-body simulator for six-axis and human-like arms with per-joint motor and drive models, an oracle-free visual reaching controller (pixels and timestamps only), its benchmark and ablations, the exact-boundary theory of the 1/e speed law, and an interactive browser-based 3D workbench.
notes: Simulation software; no hardware validation is claimed.
